runtimePolicy.colorSpace: sRGB source color maps converted to a small grayscale luminance palette before Chapter 4 palette modulation
runtimePolicy.runtimeReduction: Each 1K color map becomes one 64x64 pixel tile in memory; plaster uses a restrained 248-255 range while concrete and metal use up to six luminance levels.
runtimePolicy.sampling: NearestFilter with nearest mip levels at the 480x270 internal render resolution

materials.role: moving mechanisms, frames, and structural steel
